notes: Craven and Cate, vol. IV, ch. 2: on 12 November 1942 Major Dale D. Brannon brought in eight P-38s of the 339th Fighter Squadron (TE) to Guadalcanal, among air reinforcements rushed from Espiritu. Confidence 0.5. A departure day is not named in the chapters read.
